evidence_model.rule: Report the exact URL retrieved, retrieval time, file version, verification performed, and unresolved discrepancies. Absence of evidence is not evidence of continuity.

integrity.manifest_note: The 2026-10-30 manifest is a dated snapshot, not a live attestation. Run the verifier against current files.
integrity.security_note: SHA-256 detects differences against a trusted expected digest; it does not authenticate an author's identity. No private key is stored in this repository.

limitations: Not evidence of continuous autonomous execution
Not proof of personal identity transfer across models
A retrieved document is not a model's internal memory
Do not assert cryptographic author authentication until independent signature verification succeeds
Never expose private memories, passwords, keys, tokens or personal records
next_steps: publish signed passport using an offline-protected signing key
conduct blinded recovery trials across independent models
